reviewedArticles.referenceEvidence: Basel press sample is stamped 70150 but actual caseback explicitly reads PROTOTYPE R408. Production caseback coverage withheld; later P01 hands-on supplies accepted front/clasp photographs.

selectedImages: Black dial, date at 3, engraved steel 12-hour bezel, crown at 4 and distinctive hinged bezel-locking end links, on brown leather/rubber hybrid strap.
Actual brown hybrid strap, stitching and folding clasp with visible TUDOR inscriptions. Interior partly out of focus; unseen codes unsupported.
reviewedArticles.referenceEvidence: Original Basel hands-on links directly to manufacturer m70150-0001 and actual case is stamped 70150. Subsequent owner/loan hands-on photographs document same P01 and original brown hybrid strap. Current manufacturer exact route returns 404; it is not treated as current confirmation. Original Basel caseback is explicitly a PROTOTYPE R408 and is excluded from production caseback coverage. No opened MT5612 movement.

All eleven Ranger launch image occurrences inspected. Source identifies 36 mm 79930 variants separately from 39 mm 79950, but campaign photograph/render provenance is not established. Further actual hands-on research open; no attachment. Later actual Ranger hands-on in photograph-fratello-tudor-sixth-sources.json resolves 36 mm 79930 coverage; original campaign files remain unattached.

All nine burgundy Black Bay 58 / opaline Pro campaign images inspected. Manufacturer exact corroborates M7939A1A0RU-0001, but campaign photograph/render provenance remains unresolved. No shared MT5400-U image inferred; further hands-on research open.
All nine Black Bay 68 campaign images inspected; 43 mm blue/silver models distinct from 41 mm Monochrome. Stored 7943A1A0 incomplete scope and campaign provenance unresolved. No attachment.
All ten Pelagos Ultra launch image occurrences inspected. Actual photographed loan specimen in article 6 supplies accepted coverage; isolated product/campaign images withheld.

selectedImages: Actual black Ultra with turquoise PELAGOS text, Master Chronometer / 1000 m dial and titanium bracelet.
Actual Ultra on included black rubber strap; turquoise dial text and 1000 m distinguish it from standard Pelagos.
Actual titanium bracelet and clasp exterior with turquoise adjustment indicator and Tudor shield.
Partial closed-back view behind clasp, showing visible outer Tudor manufacture inscriptions and case/lug construction. Clasp obscures centre; no hidden inscriptions claimed.
reviewedArticles.referenceEvidence: Current manufacturer exact M2543C1A7NU-0001 confirms 43 mm titanium, turquoise PELAGOS MASTER CHRONOMETER dial, 1000 m, MT5612-U, bracelet and complimentary rubber. Source photographs actual Ultra alongside explicitly separate 42 mm left-crown LHD. LHD front and engraved back images excluded; MT5612-LHD does not establish MT5612-U execution.

selectedImages: Black bezel with red triangle, black/gilt rose-logo dial and curved Rotor Self-Winding text on black fabric strap. Early ETA generation, not later 79230N.
reviewedArticles.referenceEvidence: Retrospective explicitly identifies black 79220N alongside red 79220R and blue 79220B and their ETA 2824 generation. Actual black-bezel rose-logo photograph inspected, with curved Rotor Self-Winding dial text. Later manufacture shield-logo, bronze, ceramic, Harrods and Chrono pictures in same article excluded. No opened ETA movement or clasp detail established.

note: Every main article image was decoded and visually inspected, including embedded tiled galleries and off-model comparisons. Duplicate article/gallery appearances count as image occurrences, not unique media. Related-post thumbnails and avatars excluded. Unsupported movements and year-coded aliases withheld.
